description: Update the vision-walk-prep agents HEARTBEAT to read from BIH (via API or CLI), pull surfaced idea candidates since the last walk, and incorporate them into the Big-picture-context section of the prep deliverable. The walk skill (scenarios/prompt-manager/store/skills/packs/core/morning-vision-walk/SKILL.md) then consumes them naturally during chore-audit / big-picture-ideation phases without requiring a code change to the skill itself. This integration is what makes the BIH rework strategically valuable: it closes the leak from operators bookmark stream into Vrooli idea pipeline. Initiative: bookmark-intelligence-hub-rework-and-ideation. See orchestration-summary.md for context. Depends on: bih-ideation-extraction-agent (output format must be settled first). Acceptance: the morning of a walk, the prep deliverable includes a Bookmark-derived idea candidates since last walk subsection; vision-walk skill surfaces them conversationally during Phase 6 or 7 without skill code changes.
name: bih-vision-walk-prep-integration
title: BIH integration with vision-walk-prep (morning walk idea pipeline)
